meta.name: xchain-platform-architecture
meta.description: Component graph and end-to-end flows of the XChain Platform, a token protocol for any blockchain, live today on Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Dogecoin. Nodes are microservices, libraries, databases and external systems; edges are runtime dependencies; flows are ordered walks through the graph.
meta.source: Maintained in the xchain-documentation repo (architecture/platform-map-app.html); topology mirrors the XChain Platform service repositories. Machine-readable copy: platform-map.json.

nodes.label: Token Holder
nodes.description: End user: trades tokens, runs contracts, uses the wallet and browses the explorer.

nodes.label: Developer / Operator
nodes.description: Runs nodes, deploys services, builds integrations on the SDK, drives the e2e suite.

nodes.label: Coin Node
nodes.description: Layer-1 full node reached over JSON-RPC. Transactions carry AES-128-CTR obfuscated XCHN ACTION payloads via OP_RETURN, P2SH, P2WSH, multisig or the Taproot envelope (BTC/LTC).

nodes.label: xchain-utxo-tracker
nodes.description: Two-pass block indexer over the coin node. Persists all UTXOs and balances to LevelDB, keeps an in-memory mempool DB, and serves address/balance/UTXO queries over Express.

nodes.label: UTXO Store
nodes.description: Prefix-keyed LevelDB (B=block, T=tx, I=input, O=output, H/J=hints) of UTXOs and balances.

nodes.label: xchain-encoder
nodes.description: Builds unsigned PSBTs embedding XCHN ACTION payloads and picks the carrier (OP_RETURN, P2SH, P2WSH, multisig, Taproot, or AUTO). JSON-RPC: create_tx, estimate_fee, broadcast_tx, get_utxos. Single-instance hard constraint (PID lockfile).

nodes.label: xchain-decoder
nodes.description: Polls the coin node (blocks + mempool), deobfuscates XCHN payloads, canonicalizes 5 action aliases, validates against the 35-name allowlist and persists raw decoded actions. Detects reorgs and rolls back before re-indexing.

nodes.label: Decoder DB
nodes.description: XChain_{CHAIN}_{NETWORK}_Decoder: raw decoded XChain transactions plus mempool and transparency tables.

nodes.label: xchain-indexer
nodes.description: Reads the decoder DB and applies ACTION semantics: double-entry ledger, XCHAIN gas fees, orders/swaps/dispensers, staking capabilities, attestation validation, system-injected expiries. Executes contracts through xchain-vm and follows decoder reorgs.

nodes.label: Indexer DB
nodes.description: Canonical protocol state: balances, tokens, orders, contracts, contract_state (append-only), staking, attestation and SPV tables.

nodes.label: xchain-vm
nodes.description: Deterministic smart-contract engine: sandboxed V8 isolates, host-side gas metering, 30s CPU / 8MB memory / call depth 4 limits, hardened sandbox (constructor neutering, RegExp removal). Emits actions (XCALL, ATTEST) back to the indexer.

nodes.label: xchain-hub
nodes.description: Config oracle and cross-chain coordinator. PBFT federation (majority-floored quorum max(2f+1, ceil((N+1)/2))), five stake-qualified capabilities, price-oracle rounds, attestation engine (http_get / llm providers), reorg-retraction co-signing, governance/slash, and StateAnchorPublisher (ANCHOR v7 bundle on DOGE).

nodes.label: Hub DB
nodes.description: About 20 tables: configs, validators, consensus state, cross-chain calls, price_snapshots, oracle_prices, attestation stats.

nodes.label: xchain-explorer
nodes.description: Read-only REST + JSON-RPC + WebSocket API and web UI over indexer state (60+ endpoints, /{COIN} prefixed). Runs a hub-mirror sync for consensus tables, ABI introspection, and an optional sandboxed contract-simulation endpoint.

nodes.label: xchain-sync
nodes.description: Replicates indexer + decoder DBs to validators: REST snapshots plus a WebSocket block feed, transactional apply with rollback, merkle transparency log (sync_meta, merkle_epochs) and pinned-validator checkpoint quorum verification.

nodes.label: Validator / Replica Nodes
nodes.description: Downstream validator stacks fed by xchain-sync. Run their own indexer/explorer against replicated state and re-verify state commitments.

nodes.label: xchain-regtest-miner
nodes.description: Regtest-only auto-miner: dual-timer mempool mining, generate_blocks, send_funds, fill_mempool stress tool, set_mock_time for deterministic expiries. Refused on mainnet.

nodes.label: xchain-sdk
nodes.description: Developer SDK generating all 31 user ACTION types with ticker compaction and a MuSig2 co-signer toolkit. Discovers endpoints via hub getallconfigs with an https downgrade guard; defaults to public .xchain.io hosts off-regtest.

nodes.label: xchain-wallet
nodes.tech: JS monorepo: web SPA, MV3 extension, Electron, Capacitor mobile
nodes.description: Self-custodial multi-chain wallet built on the SDK. Packages: core (shell-free, enforced by CI), web, extension, desktop, mobile (Capacitor; Android shipped, iOS later), plus Trezor/Ledger signer packages. Signs PSBTs locally; keys never leave the device.

nodes.label: xchain-node
nodes.description: Installer/operator CLI: provisions coin nodes (SHA-256 pinned binaries) and every platform service as Docker containers. Ed25519-signed bootstraps, go-live and skew guards, telemetry (opt-out), interactive TUI.

nodes.label: xchain-e2e-test
nodes.description: Full-stack end-to-end suite: broadcasts real transactions on regtest through service connectors (Blockchain, Encoder, Indexer, Hub, UtxoTracker, RegtestMiner), 30+ waitFor* DB pollers, BTC/LTC/DOGE parity corpus, perf gates.

nodes.label: xchain-contracts
nodes.description: Smart-contract template library (amm, escrow, vesting, crowdsale, treasury, priceBet, stableVault, urlOracle, cardDispenser) plus a policy-driven controller-guard generator. Deployed as base64 DEPLOY actions; tested against xchain-vm.

nodes.label: xchain-documentation
nodes.description: Protocol reference: per-ACTION specs, gas/fee schedule, Token Information Standard schema, architecture, operator and user guides.

nodes.label: xchain-websites
nodes.description: Builds xchain.io, the docs site (with search index), bootstrap/database download pages, and verifies the live encoder catalog against deployment.

edges.label: templates linted + tested against the VM

flows.name: Submit an action (write path)
flows.description: A user sends a token action from the wallet all the way to confirmed, indexed protocol state.

steps.action: User initiates an action (SEND, ISSUE, ORDER, ...) in the wallet.
Wallet composes the pipe-delimited ACTION payload via the SDK.
SDK calls encoder create_tx with the payload and funding address.
Encoder fetches spendable UTXOs from the utxo-tracker and builds an unsigned PSBT (carrier chosen: OP_RETURN, P2SH, P2WSH, multisig or Taproot).
Wallet signs the PSBT locally; keys never leave the device.
Signed transaction is broadcast to the coin node mempool via broadcast_tx.
Transaction confirms in a block; decoder polls it out.
Decoder deobfuscates the XCHN payload and persists the raw action.
Indexer reads the decoded action and applies protocol semantics (ledger moves, XCHAIN gas fee).
Canonical state is written to the indexer DB.
Explorer serves the new balance/action to users and the wallet.

flows.name: Block confirmation pipeline
flows.description: The core read pipeline: coin node to decoder to indexer to explorer, with reorg rollback at each stage.

steps.action: Decoder polls each new block (and mempool every 60s).
XCHN payloads are deobfuscated, alias-canonicalized, allowlist-validated and persisted.
Indexer picks up new decoded rows (and detects decoder-side reorg rollbacks).
DEPLOY/EXECUTE actions run inside xchain-vm isolates with gas metering.
State changes and emitted actions are folded into the block result and written.
Explorer and sync both consume the canonical state.
REST / JSON-RPC / WebSocket clients see the confirmed block.

flows.name: Smart-contract deploy + execute
flows.description: A contract template goes from the contracts library through DEPLOY/EXECUTE to append-only contract state.

steps.action: Template (amm, escrow, vesting, ...) is authored and tested against xchain-vm; guard contracts can be generated from a JSON policy.
Contract code is base64-encoded into a DEPLOY action (or EXECUTE with method + params) and sent to the encoder. DEPOSIT + method calls travel together as a BATCH.
PSBT is built, signed by the caller and broadcast.
Confirmed action flows down the decode pipeline.
Raw DEPLOY/EXECUTE persisted.
Indexer drives beginBlock, DEPLOY/EXECUTE in the sandbox, endBlock; gas is charged in XCHAIN.
Deterministic result (state changes, emitted actions, logs) is committed; contract custody uses derived address C:CHAIN:index.
Contract page shows ABI, state and executions; optional sandboxed read-only simulation.

flows.name: Cross-chain call (XCALL)
flows.description: A contract on one chain calls a contract on another via VM emission and the hub federation.

steps.action: Source-chain contract calls xchain.emit.crossExecute(...), emitting XCALL v0 with a deterministic sha256 request_id.
Source indexer records the cross-chain call and surfaces it to the hub.
Hub federation reaches the cross_chain quorum on the call (stake-weighted at/above STAKE_WEIGHTED_QUORUM_ACTIVATION, otherwise the majority-floored signer count) and tracks it in cross_chain_calls.
Target-chain indexer receives the mirrored call and system-injects XEXEC (no on-chain tx on the target).
Target contract executes in the VM; results settle into target-chain state.
If the deadline passes without quorum, XCALL v2 expiry is system-synthesized and escrow refunded.

flows.name: External attestation round-trip
flows.description: A contract requests off-chain data; the hub federation fetches, agrees and answers on-chain.

steps.action: Contract calls xchain.attestation.request(providerId, payload, callback...), emitting ATTEST v0 with gas escrow.
Request lands in protocol state; hub validators poll getpendingattestation_requests.
A responsible set is selected by hash ordering; the provider fetches (http_get byte-equality or llm judge-model) and PBFT consensus runs.
AttestationPublisher submits ATTEST v1 (response) on-chain through the encoder.
Response transaction is broadcast and confirms.
Decoder persists the ATTEST v1 action.
Indexer validates the cross_chain quorum of signatures and fires the contract's callback EXECUTE; on deadline expiry it injects ATTEST v2 and refunds escrow.

flows.name: PRICE oracle + native-fee pricing
flows.description: Validator price rounds flow on-chain and back into every indexer for fee conversion.

steps.action: Oracle rounds run in the federation; price-capable signers agree COIN/FIAT snapshots.
An oracle_publish-capable publisher broadcasts PRICE v0 through the encoder.
PRICE transaction is broadcast and confirms.
Decoder persists the PRICE action from the chain.
Hub indexes snapshots into price_snapshots / oracle_prices (its local DB copy).
Every indexer reads the price tables during block processing to convert native-coin fees to XCHAIN.

flows.name: Validator replication (xchain-sync)
flows.description: How a validator or replica node acquires and verifies platform state without trusting the source.

steps.action: Sync server snapshots the indexer DB and tails new blocks.
Decoder DB is snapshotted too (8 of 9 tables; transparency/mempool excluded by design).
Replicas bootstrap over REST snapshots then follow the WebSocket block feed.
ClientApplier applies transactionally (batches of 100, rollback support); merkle epochs and pinned-validator checkpoint quorum verify the stream.

flows.name: State anchoring (ANCHOR on DOGE)
flows.description: Quorum-signed per-chain state checkpoints are anchored on Dogecoin as one ANCHOR v7 bundle per network, for chain-parse recoverability.

steps.action: StateAnchorPublisher runs one publisher election per bundle by hash ordering and assembles every checkpointed chain's quorum-signed checkpoint as its own bundle section, plus the compressed cross-chain match archive.
ONE ANCHOR v7 checkpoint bundle per network per publishing cycle is built and submitted through the DOGE encoder from the elected publisher's own DOGE wallet.
Anchor transaction is broadcast on Dogecoin.
DOGE decoder picks the ANCHOR out of the block.
Indexers verify and record the checkpoint; RewardTracker records publisher rewards.

flows.name: Regtest e2e campaign
flows.description: How the full stack is exercised end to end with real transactions on regtest.

steps.action: Operator runs the Mocha suite (mainnet guard refuses NETWORK=mainnet).
Action tests build and broadcast real transactions through the encoder connector; no mocking at the action level.
Transactions enter the regtest mempool.
Regtest miner mines on demand (or on its dual timers); set_mock_time pins clocks for deterministic expiries.
Blocks are mined; the pipeline processes them.
30+ waitFor* pollers assert indexer state; the parity corpus asserts identical state across BTC/LTC/DOGE.

flows.name: Explore (read path)
flows.description: A user browses balances, actions and contracts without touching a wallet.

steps.action: User opens the explorer UI or hits the REST/WebSocket API.
Explorer answers from the indexer DB (read-only, parameterized SQL).
Consensus/governance tables come from the hub mirror; config is auto-refreshed from the hub every 60s.
